# Закрытие фазы P7

> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: P1 baseline/compatibility/guarantees,
terminal P6 semantic manifest и residuals, current manifests/source/consumers. Производит:
package-boundary contract, exact PHP/Dart API manifests, dev-only testkit/reference contours,
archive allowlists, migration map и built-artifact consumer receipt. Границы: не меняет
P2–P6 semantics, не публикует package и не берёт P8/P9/P10 gates.

## Произведено

- P7.1 — Заморозить package-boundary contract и target API manifests: Versioned boundary policy, exact target package-surface contract, deterministic inventory/diff tool and repository-grounded current→target migration report.
- P7.2 — Отделить PHP core от testkit/reference и закрыть API drift: Intentional PHP stable/advanced surface, dev-only testkit/reference contour, production-clean Composer archive policy, migration guide and exact API-drift evidence.
- P7.3 — Сузить Dart exports и закрепить testkit/MCP companion boundary: Narrow Dart core API, explicit testkit library, preserved optional MCP companion boundary, exact export manifest, API docs and migration evidence.
- P7.4 — Доказать archive allowlists, migrations и clean consumers: Reproducible private package artifacts, exact archive inventories/checksums, three clean-consumer receipts, compiled migration proof and integrated P7 package-boundary verdict.

## Known Deviations

- P7.3: Dart core barrel no longer exports InMemory*/FixedClock/StaticTokenKeyProvider; agentools_testkit.dart is the supported test-double library. SqlEventStore uses EventStoreSupport. dart format/analyze/test green in both packages; dart doc 0 warnings; package-surface pending 0. Deviation: Dart 3.13 does not emit implementation_imports; companion src-import mutant is red via tools/package_surface.py instead. Format-only dart format of existing files for the format gate. D16 Composer 2.5 vs Grok 4.6 overshoot.

## Решения

- [D12](../../decisions/D12-intentional-package-surfaces.md)

sections.title: DoR (Definition of Ready)
sections.text:
- [x] Текущие Composer autoload, Dart barrels, reference/test doubles и consumers инвентаризированы в `@plan/knowledge/research-P7-design.json`.
- [x] D12 закрепляет manifest-first boundary, dev-only PHP contour, separate Dart testkit library и no-split default.
- [x] Composer archive/autoload-dev и Dart library/pub archive rules проверены по primary sources.
- [x] Stable API отделён от candidate reachability; removal stable symbol без migration не разрешён.
- [ ] P1.1/P1.3/P1.4 и P6.5 закрыты GREEN и их digest-qualified outputs доступны.

sections.title: Scope Included
sections.text:
Repository-wide current/target API inventory; stable/advanced/testkit/reference/internal taxonomy;
PHP namespace/autoload/archive boundary; Dart explicit public libraries and exports; `agentools_mcp_dart`
optional dependency boundary; in-memory/fixed/reference implementations; deterministic API manifests and
BC drift gate; archive allowlists; compatibility/deprecation map; examples and clean consumers installed
only from locally built package artifacts.

sections.title: Scope Excluded
sections.text:
Semantic redesign P2–P6; source generation; framework/Laravel/Flutter adapters; new production storage
adapter; mutation/fuzz/performance depth; CI permissions/matrices/SBOM/provenance; registry identity,
public tag/upload or hosted dependency selection; moving directories only for aesthetics; claiming that
private/local archive evidence equals a public release.

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.text:
P7.1 waits for terminal P1.1/P1.3/P1.4 and P6.5 outputs. P7.2 and P7.3 wait for P7.1 and may
execute in dependency-safe order. P7.4 waits for P7.2–P7.3 and validates only built artifacts.
D2 still forbids every product item before P1–P10 detail and GREEN whole-plan design audit.
P8 consumes manifests/mutants, P9 integrates gates and release automation, P10 accepts the final RC.
